inquiry.title: Quick Inquiry
inquiry.heading: Tell us about your project
inquiry.label: Project scope & location *
inquiry.placeholder: Tell us the equipment, project location, inspection stage and target dates.
inquiry.context: Include the equipment, vendor or project location, inspection stage and target dates. A specification or inspection plan is a useful starting point.

feedback.title: Feedback
feedback.heading: Tell us about your experience
feedback.label: Your feedback & suggestions *
feedback.placeholder: What worked well? What could we improve about the inspection, reporting or communication?
feedback.context: Share the project or report reference if available. Tell us what worked well and where the service could improve.

complaint_appeal.title: Complaint / Appeal
complaint_appeal.heading: Help us understand your concern
complaint_appeal.label: Grounds for complaint or appeal *
complaint_appeal.placeholder: Describe the relevant events, the observation or decision in question and the outcome you are seeking.
complaint_appeal.context: Include the inspection or project reference, relevant dates and the outcome you are seeking. A supporting report can help explain your concern.

doc_verify.title: Inspection Certificate Verification
doc_verify.heading: Request a document check
doc_verify.label: Document details & purpose of verification *
doc_verify.placeholder: Tell us what you need to confirm about this document. Add the issuing details if known.
doc_verify.context: Provide the document number and type, plus the issue date if known. You may attach a copy. Our team will review the request against the relevant records.
